period_note: Sourced directly from the bank's own primary half-yearly interim financial statements ("Financial Statements for the Half Yearly ended 30 June 2018 (Unaudited)"), used as the Q2 data point. Per project convention the SOLO ('Balance Sheet as at 30 June 2018' / 'Profit and Loss Account for the half year ended 30 June 2018') figures are used, not 'Consolidated'. Arithmetically verified: Total liabilities 287,450.33m + Total equity 25,232.23m = Total assets 312,682.56m exactly; Net interest income + Investment income + Commission + Other operating income = Total operating income (7,376.49m) exactly; each subtotal down to Net profit after tax (1,220.77m) reconciles exactly. Non Funded Income is calculated as Commission/exchange/brokerage + Other operating income (both individually reported). NAV per share is not disclosed in the primary interim statement and is left out as a genuine gap. 2018 Q1 could not be recovered: the bank's own archive (legacy.citybankplc.com) lists only a corrupted placeholder file for that quarter ('This is a test PDF file') and no other capture exists on Wayback Machine; recorded as a genuine gap.
